clapping.description: Four equal cells in reading order: hands apart, hands clapping, hands apart, hands clapping with a delighted closed-eye smile. Fixed camera, full body, matching watercolor style and pale cream background.

hemulen.description: Stationary scene with head-only motion: look toward the flower, tilt toward the viewer, then return. Four transparent head poses become 24 eased intermediate frames around a fixed neck pivot.
